title: Implement a simple Bloom filter in Rust
description: Implement BloomFilter with insert(item: &str) and might_contain(item: &str) -> bool. Use k=3 independent hash functions derived from std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher with different seeds.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement BloomFilter in src/lib.rs:
- Store a `Vec<bool>` of `size` bits initialized to false
- Use 3 hash functions: for seed in [1u64, 2, 3], create a `DefaultHasher`, call `write_u64(seed)` then `write(item.as_bytes())`, use `finish() % size as u64` as the bit index
- `insert`: set all 3 bit positions to true
- `might_contain`: return true only if all 3 bit positions are true
All 3 tests must pass.
followup_prompts: Run `cargo test --quiet` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `cargo test --quiet` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
